description: Shared type definitions for lexicon versioning. Provides a reusable convention for tracking schema revisions and changelogs.

revision.description: Current version of a lexicon schema, following semver conventions.

major.description: Breaking changes or new NSID required.

minor.description: New optional fields or non-breaking additions.

patch.description: Documentation, description, or metadata changes only.

changelogEntry.description: A single entry in a lexicon's changelog.

description.description: Summary of changes in this version.
